description: Wi-Fiスポット(韓国語) [telecom] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐賀県. 본 사이트에 게재되어 있는 시설정보 중에는 일부 일본어로 게재되어 있는 시설정보도 포함되어 있으나, 이들에 대해서는 번역 작업이 완료되는대로 수시로 내용을 변경하도록 하겠습니다. Coverage: 佐賀県. The portal files it under the publisher 佐賀県. Its tags are Wi-Fi, インフラ, 観光, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
